summary.zh: 从五个维度重看方向、假设与偏见
summary.en: Recheck direction, assumptions and bias from five angles

description.zh: 当工作已经沉到细节里，可以停下来从方向、假设、偏见等五个维度检查是否还在正轨上。适合阶段复盘、重大决定前的自查，或在长任务中途需要重新对齐时使用，不需要额外配置。
description.en: Steps back to reassess direction, assumptions and bias across five dimensions when work has sunk into detail. Useful mid-project or before a decision, to check the effort still serves the goal.
